name: LocaleRegistry
src_typeComment: The list of every language the game ships with. This is the concrete subclass GameDataRegistry<T>'s own comment asks for — Unity cannot put [CreateAssetMenu] on a generic type, so the pattern is to subclass it once per data type. Nothing else is needed: GetById("fr") and All come from the base class.  Assign one of these to LocalizationManager and every LocaleAsset in its list becomes a selectable language.
